register.title: Create an account with a WhatsApp number
register.intro: Register with a Palestinian mobile number for fast, safe activation
register.about: The first interactive platform connecting users with service providers and property owners in Palestine. Whether you look for a service or have a property to sell or rent, we give you smart geographic marketing that reaches the public directly.
register.term1: The platform is a geo-digital intermediary that connects the user with the provider through WhatsApp only.
register.term2: Prices, appointments and service details are agreed directly between the two parties, without our involvement.
register.term3: The platform accepts no responsibility for any dispute, mistreatment or breach of agreement between the parties.
register.term4: For complaints, message us on the Facebook page so that administrative action (such as a ban) can be taken.
